invite.description: They get a link to choose a password and sign in. No Microsoft account is needed.

invited.title: Sign-in link ready
invited.lead: Share this link with the invited person, or send it again from the members list later.
invited.summary: {email} is added as {role, select, tenant_admin {tenant admin} other {user}}.
invited.reusedSummary: {email} already had an account on {appName}. It is added to this tenant, and can choose a password with this link.
invited.alreadySignedIn: {email} already has a way to sign in and is now added to this tenant as {role, select, tenant_admin {tenant admin} other {user}}. There is nothing to send. They can sign in right away.
invited.microsoftHint: Microsoft sign-in is available on this installation, but only for accounts already linked to Microsoft. This one is not, so {email} signs in with the password from this link instead.

added.title: Added to this tenant
added.lead: This person already has a way to sign in. There is nothing to send. They can sign in right away.

mail.sent: A message with this link was sent to {email}.
mail.notConfigured: No mail transport is configured, so the link was not emailed. Copy it and pass it on yourself.
mail.failed: Sending the mail failed. Copy the link and pass it on yourself instead.

provision.expiresUnknown: The link is valid for a limited time.
provision.linkHint: The link works once. Reissuing a new one invalidates this one.

linkDialog.title: New sign-in link
linkDialog.description: The previous link for {email} no longer works; share this one instead.

errors.crossTenant: This account already belongs to a different tenant. Only a provider administrator can add it here too.
errors.providerAdminTarget: This account administers the whole installation and already reaches every tenant.
errors.notPending: This person already has a working way to sign in; there is no link to reissue.

pending.title: Pending sign-in setup
pending.description: Added to the tenant, but no password has been set yet.
pending.error: Pending accounts could not be loaded.

reissueConfirm.title: Issue a new sign-in link?
reissueConfirm.description: {email} already has an active link. Issuing a new one stops that one from working immediately.

setPassword.error: This link could not be checked.
setPassword.title: Choose a password
setPassword.lead: Set a password to sign in to {appName}. An authenticator app is required right after.
setPassword.leadWithEmail: Set a password for {email} to sign in to {appName}. An authenticator app is required right after.

done.title: Password set
done.description: You can now sign in. You will be asked to set up an authenticator app right after.

used.title: This link has already been used
used.description: A password was already set with this link. Sign in instead, or ask an administrator for a new link.
used.descriptionWithEmail: A password was already set for {email} with this link. Sign in instead, or ask an administrator for a new link.

expired.title: This link has expired
expired.description: Sign-in links are valid for 72 hours. Ask an administrator to send a new one.
expired.descriptionWithEmail: The link for {email} is more than 72 hours old. Ask an administrator to send a new one.

invalid.title: This link is not valid
invalid.description: It may be mistyped or already removed. Ask an administrator to send a new one.
invalid.descriptionWithEmail: It may be mistyped or already removed. Ask an administrator to send a new one.

setPassword.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.

linkError.used: This link has already been used. Ask an administrator for a new one.
linkError.expired: This link has expired. Ask an administrator for a new one.

mail.subject: Set your password for {tenant} on {appName}
mail.body: You have been added to {tenant} on {appName}. Open this link within {hours} hours to choose a password and sign in: {url}
mail.providerSubject: You have been added to the provider team on {appName}
mail.providerBody: You have been added to the provider team on {appName}. Open this link within {hours} hours to choose a password and sign in; you will then set up an authenticator app: {url}
